items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dr. Arnold said to me, “Brubeck, why don’t you go across the lawn to the conservatory, because your mind is not here in the lab.”

ctx.x: Let’s go back now and talk about college. How did you go from planning on a career as a veterinarian to deciding you were going to study music and be a musician?

It’s really up to my zoology teacher. Dr. Arnold said to me, “Brubeck, why don’t you go across the lawn to the conservatory, because your mind is not here in the lab.” I took his advice. Went across the lawn to the conservatory the next year.
How did your parents react to your decision to become a musician?
